title: StackStartParams
description: stack.start's params: what semiont start takes, but its help and its narration switches.

apiVersion.description: The version of the control API the request is written to.

target.description: Which knowledge base's stack. Absent: the one the command line chooses, standing where the control server was started.

runtime.description: The container runtime to ask, as --runtime names it. Absent: the one the stack's record names, else every installed one.

config.description: The Inference document to run, as --config names it. Absent: the knowledge base's recorded preference, else the default.

service.description: Just this one service, as --service names it.

group.description: Just this one group of services, as --group names it.

codespaceName.description: For a codespace target: which of the repository's codespaces, as --codespace names it.

machine.description: For a codespace target being created: its VM class, as --machine names it.

idleTimeout.description: For a codespace target being created: inactivity before it stops, as --idle-timeout takes it.

retentionPeriod.description: For a codespace target being created: how long a stopped codespace is kept, as --retention-period takes it.

observe.description: Whether to start the telemetry backends, Jaeger and Prometheus. false is --no-observe. Absent: true.

ollamaCache.description: Where a started Ollama keeps its models, as --ollama-cache names it. Absent: the host's ~/.ollama when there is one, else the named volume — what the command line's prompt does when nobody answers it.

dryRun.description: Whether to run nothing, and report each runtime command a start would run as a command progress line.
